arxiv-2007-10756.creator: Pankaj Pandey, Raunak Swarnkar, Shobhit Kakaria, Krishna Prasad Miyapuram
arxiv-2007-10756.description: Abstract Neuromarketing aims to understand consumer behavior using neuroscience. Brain imaging tools such as EEG have been used to better understand consumer behavior that goes beyond self-report measures which can be a more accurate measure to understand how and why consumers prefer choosing one product over another.

arxiv-2102-05369.title: Topological phases in N- layer ABC- graphene boron-nitride moire superlattices
arxiv-2102-05369.creator: David Andrés Galeano González, Bheema Lingam Chittari, Youngju Park, Jin-Hua Sun, Jeil Jung
arxiv-2102-05369.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by David Andrés Galeano González, Bheema Lingam Chittari, Youngju Park, Jin-Hua Sun, Jeil Jung. Rhombohedral N = 3 N=3 trilayer graphene on hexagonal boron nitride (TLG/BN) hosts gate-tunable, valley-contrasting, nearly flat topological bands that can trigger spontaneous quantum Hall phases under appropriate conditions of the valley and spin polarization. Recent experiments have shown signatures of C = 2 valley Chern bands at 1/4 hole filling, in contrast to the predicted value of C = 3.

arxiv-2103-05269.title: Baryon production in the quantized fragmentation of helical QCD string
arxiv-2103-05269.creator: Šárka Todorova-Nová
arxiv-2103-05269.description: Abstract Baryon production is studied within the framework of quantized fragmentation of QCD string. Baryons appear in the model in a fairly intuitive way, with help of causally connected string breakups. A simple helical approximation of QCD flux tube with parameters constrained by mass spectrum of light mesons is sufficient to reproduce masses of light baryons.

arxiv-2405-04535.title: IMAGE CLASSIFICATION FOR CSSVD DETECTION IN CACAO PLANTS
arxiv-2405-04535.creator: Atuhurra Jesse, N’guessan Yves-Roland Douha, Pabitra Lenka
arxiv-2405-04535.description: Abstract The detection of diseases within plants has attracted a lot of attention from computer vision enthusiasts. Despite the progress made to detect diseases in many plants, there remains a research gap to train image classifiers to detect the cacao swollen shoot virus disease or CSSVD for short, pertinent to cacao plants.

arxiv-2406-17271.title: DARG: Dynamic Evaluation of Large Language Models via Adaptive Reasoning Graph
arxiv-2406-17271.creator: Zhehao Zhang, Jiaao Chen, Diyi Yang
arxiv-2406-17271.description: Abstract The current paradigm of evaluating Large Language Models (LLMs) through static benchmarks comes with significant limitations, such as vulnerability to data contamination and a lack of adaptability to the evolving capabilities of LLMs. Therefore, evaluation methods that can adapt and generate evaluation data with controlled complexity are urgently needed.

arxiv-2406-18357.title: Restricted baby Skyrme-Maxwell theory in a magnetic medium: BPS configurations and some properties
arxiv-2406-18357.creator: J. Andrade, Rodolfo Casana, E. da Hora, A. C. Santos
arxiv-2406-18357.description: Abstract We study the existence of BPS configurations in a restricted baby Skyrme-Maxwell enlarged via the inclusion of a nontrivial magnetic permeability. In order to attain such a goal, we use the Bogomol’nyi-Prasad-Sommerfield prescription, which allows us to obtain the lower bound for the energy and the BPS equations whose [electrically neutral] solutions saturate that bound.

arxiv-2410-03015.description: Abstract We explore strategies aimed at reducing the amount of computation, both quantum and classical, required to run the Quantum Approximate Optimization Algorithm (QAOA). arxiv-2412-02748.title: Intertwined order of generalized global symmetries
arxiv-2412-02748.creator: Benjamin Moy and Eduardo Fradkin
arxiv-2412-02748.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Benjamin Moy and Eduardo Fradkin. We investigate the interplay of generalized global symmetries in 2+1 dimensions in a lattice model that couples a ℤ N \mathbb{Z}_{N} clock model to a ℤ N \mathbb{Z}_{N} gauge theory via a topological interaction. This coupling binds the charges of one symmetry to the disorder operators of the other, and when these composite objects condense, they give rise to emergent generalized symmetries with mixed ’t Hooft anomalies.

arxiv-2508-04913.title: Advancing Hate Speech Detection with Transformers: Insights from the MetaHate
arxiv-2508-04913.creator: Santosh Chapagain, Shah Muhammad Hamdi, Soukaina Filali Boubrahimi
arxiv-2508-04913.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Santosh Chapagain, Shah Muhammad Hamdi, Soukaina Filali Boubrahimi. Hate speech is a widespread and harmful form of online discourse, encompassing slurs and defamatory posts that can have serious social, psychological, and sometimes physical impacts on targeted individuals and communities. As social media platforms such as X (formerly Twitter), Facebook, Instagram, Reddit, and others continue to facilitate widespread communication, they also become breeding grounds for hate speech, which has increasingly been linked to real-world hate crimes.

arxiv-2512-09542.title: Cathodoluminescence Study of a Quantum Dot in a Nanowire for Single-Photon Emission
arxiv-2512-09542.creator: Francis Granger, Fabrice Donatini, Edith Bellet-Amalric, Kuntheak Kheng, Gilles Nogues, David Ferrand, Joël Cibert
arxiv-2512-09542.description: Abstract Cathodoluminescence in a scanning electron microscope was applied to a semiconductor quantum dot in a nanowire able to emit single photons. We show that cathodoluminescence can be used not only for imaging and spectroscopy, but also to measure the correlation function and characterize the purity of the single-photon emitter.

uslaw-usc-t49-s22901.title: 49 U.S.C. § 22901 — Definitions
uslaw-usc-t49-s22901.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t49-s22901.description: United States Code, Title 49 (Transportation); Part B (Assistance); Chapter 229 (Rail Improvement Grants). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. In this chapter: (1) Applicant.— The term “applicant” means a State (including the District of Columbia), a group of States, an Interstate Compact, or a public agency established by one or more States and having responsibility for providing intercity passenger rail service.
